title: Rick H Possible NDE 4228
content: My kids had just got off the bus and we were talking and I was telling them that I love them and was talking to them. (I mention this because that is my last memory of that day.) I wake up four days later in the critical care unit, where my wife tells me I seized while I was asleep in our bed. During the time I was out: I continually had a white veil covering my physical eyes. During which time I could hear arguing in the background, all the while getting a strange feeling as though it were all over me. Yet there was only one voice that I could hear clearly. I heard the accusations against me. Those words still to this day ring in my mind. Afterwards, I was standing above the world looking down upon it, just as I saw the creation begin and every man and woman that is upon the earth today, then I saw a fire spread across the land for I then knew many answers. At this point, I began to feel heavy as I realized I saw my body lying lifeless in a bed with a blanket on it. I became so heavy and painful and feelings I would not wish upon my worst enemy. The veil is removed. I opened my eyes and I see two women, one giving me more drugs to bring me back, asking me if I know where I am. My beautiful wife as I tell her I love her. Once released from the hospital I told my wife of these things as soon as we were in the car and passed out for several more days. She then had to take me to a Veterans Affairs hospital. For many days after being released from the hospital, I would know strangers from having seen them before. This drove me nuts. Now I can hardly remember anything.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: He reports 'standing above the world looking down upon it' and also seeing his 'body lying lifeless in a bed with a blanket on it.'
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: He reports feeling 'heavy and painful' with 'feelings I would not wish upon my worst enemy.'

environment.environment_other_detail: He describes a 'white veil' over his eyes, being 'above the world looking down upon it,' seeing 'the creation begin,' and seeing 'a fire spread across the land.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He reports the 'veil is removed' and then he opens his eyes in the hospital while a woman is 'giving me more drugs to bring me back.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Seizure while asleep in bed (as reported by his wife).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He reports hearing 'arguing' and 'accusations against me,' a 'white veil' over his eyes, being above the world/creation imagery, then seeing his body in bed, then awakening in hospital.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Auditory perceptions and a 'white veil' occur before the OBE 'above the world' and before seeing his body in bed; no tunnel/light-being/life review/boundary is described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Persistent 'white veil' over his physical eyes during unconsciousness; hearing a single clear accusing voice amid arguing; seeing 'the creation begin' and a fire spreading across the land; after discharge, recognizing strangers 'from having seen them before.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: Key phrases: 'white veil covering my physical eyes'; 'I heard the accusations against me'; 'standing above the world looking down upon it'; 'I saw the creation begin'; 'then I saw a fire spread across the land'; 'I saw my body lying lifeless in a bed with a blanket on it'; 'For many days... I would know strangers from having seen them before.'
